package storetranslatefixture

import (
	"slices"

	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/ast"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/collections"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/internal/core"
)

// The rules of 7d-2a (store-checker-7d2a-implementation-instructions-20260929.md
// 3.3), one function or more each.

// R2: the list methods, and a field read on the data of a node.
func r2(node *ast.Node) int {
	n := len(node.TypeArgumentList().Nodes) + len(node.ModifierNodes())
	for range node.FunctionLikeData().Parameters.Nodes {
		n++
	}
	return n
}

// R3: the file's node, a NodeRef field, the refs of a slice, a method.
func r3(sf *ast.SourceFile) int {
	root := sf.AsNode()
	n := 0
	if sf.ExternalModuleIndicator == nil && root != nil {
		n++
	}
	for _, augmentation := range sf.ModuleAugmentations {
		if augmentation.Kind == ast.KindIdentifier {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n + len(sf.Statements.Nodes)
}

// R4: a list where a helper of core or slices takes []*ast.Node.
func r4(node *ast.Node, arg *ast.Node) bool {
	return core.Some(node.Arguments(), func(n *ast.Node) bool { return n.Kind == ast.KindIdentifier }) &&
		slices.Index(node.Arguments(), arg) >= 0
}

// R4': a list that flows into a []*ast.Node.
func r4prime(node *ast.Node, i int) []*ast.Node {
	var args []*ast.Node
	args = node.Arguments()
	if i > 0 {
		return args[:i]
	}
	return node.AsCallExpression().Arguments.Nodes
}

// R5: a links store and a set keyed by a node.
type links struct {
	nodeLinks core.LinkStore[*ast.Node, int]
	seen      collections.Set[*ast.Node]
}

func (l *links) r5(node *ast.Node) int {
	l.seen.Add(node)
	*l.nodeLinks.Get(node) = 1
	return *l.nodeLinks.Get(node)
}

// R6: the comparable helpers with SameNode.
func r6(a, b *ast.Node, nodes []*ast.Node) *ast.Node {
	_ = slices.Compact(nodes)
	return core.Coalesce(a, b)
}

// R7 and R8: the checker's factory, a clone, and the writes through it.
type checker struct {
	factory ast.NodeFactory
}

func (c *checker) r7(node *ast.Node) *ast.Node {
	return node.Clone(&c.factory)
}

func (c *checker) r8(node *ast.Node, parent *ast.Node, list *ast.NodeList, i int) {
	node.Parent = parent
	node.Loc = core.NewTextRange(-1, -1)
	node.Flags |= ast.NodeFlagsSynthesized
	list.Loc = parent.Loc
	list.Nodes[i] = node
	node.AsImportTypeNode().IsTypeOf = true
}

// R11: a callback on the parse diagnostics of a file takes *ast.Diagnostic.
func r11(sf *ast.SourceFile) bool {
	return core.Some(sf.Diagnostics(), func(d *ast.Diagnostic) bool { return d.Code() == 1 })
}

// An integer conversion of an ast.NodeId packs the NodeKey.
func nodeIdKey(node *ast.Node) uint64 {
	return uint64(ast.GetNodeId(node))
}

// A switch on a node compares with SameNode.
func identitySwitch(node *ast.Node, a *ast.Node) int {
	switch node {
	case a:
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

// A type switch on a value that is not a node.
func typeSwitch(v any) int {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case *ast.Node:
		if x != nil {
			return 1
		}
	case string:
		return len(x)
	}
	return 0
}
